findings.summary: The takeover intent Event is never cleared, so a successful same-coordinator handoff back to manager leaves all future automatic admission permanently held.
Authority is checked before the actual socket write with no atomic submission claim. Takeover can win after current() but before _send_until and a new frame can still be transmitted.
The legacy CommandPort fallback performs a one-time permit check and then invokes a token-unaware send; official production uses send_bound but generic coordinator safety is overstated.

acceptance.C-AC-18: not met due handoff and final check-to-send races; external OMP pending
